atomic_facts.fact: Trevor Milton was sentenced to four years in prison.
The sentence was imposed in December 2023.
The sentence was for securities and wire fraud.
Trevor Milton received a presidential pardon for his fraud conviction.
The pardon was a full pardon.
The pardon was granted on March 27, 2025.
Sources differ on whether the pardon occurred on March 27 or March 28.
The higher-weight sources support the March 27 date.
Trevor Milton has not served any of his four-year prison sentence.
As of October 1, 2026, Trevor Milton is not incarcerated.
